blocks.prompt: 15 If \(a, b, c\) are in G.P., show that \(\log_a x, \log_b x, \log_c x\) are in H.P.
blocks.explanation:
Is proof mein logarithm (log) aata hai, lekin asool wahi purana hai: H.P. saabit karni ho to reciprocals ki A.P. saabit karo.
Log ki ek khoobsurat property: \(\log_a x\) ka reciprocal \(\log_x a\) hota hai (base aur number jagah badal lete hain).
Plan: \(b^{2} = ac\) par \(\log_x\) laga kar dikhao ke \(\log_x a, \log_x b, \log_x c\) A.P. mein hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b, c\) G.P. mein (positive, 1 ke barabar nahi); \(x > 0\), \(x \ne 1\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\log_a x, \log_b x, \log_c x\) H.P. mein hain.
Tareeqa: Change of base se \(\log_a x = \frac{1}{\log_x a}\). Is liye kaafi hai ke hum \(\log_x a, \log_x b, \log_x c\) ko A.P. mein dikha dein.

G.P. wali shart
\[b^{2} = ac\]
Kyun: G.P. mein ratio barabar hota hai: \(\frac{b}{a} = \frac{c}{b}\). Cross-multiply karein to \(b^{2} = ac\).

Dono taraf \(\log_x\) lein
\[\log_x b^{2} = \log_x (ac)\]
\[2\log_x b = \log_x a + \log_x c\]
Kyun: Log ke do qawaneen: power aage aa jati hai, \(\log_x b^{2} = 2\log_x b\); aur product ka log alag alag logs ka jama hota hai, \(\log_x (ac) = \log_x a + \log_x c\). Log products ko jama mein badal deta hai, isi liye G.P. (multiply wali) A.P. (jama wali) ban jati hai.

Isay A.P. ki tarah parhein
\[\log_x a, \; \log_x b, \; \log_x c \text{ A.P. mein hain}\]
Kyun: Darmiyani term ka double dono kinaron ke jame ke barabar hai, aur yahi A.P. ki pehchaan hai.

Reciprocals lein
\[\dfrac{1}{\log_x a} = \log_a x\]
\[\log_a x, \; \log_b x, \; \log_c x \text{ H.P. mein hain}\]
Kyun: A.P. ke reciprocals H.P. bante hain, aur har \(\log_x a\) ka reciprocal \(\log_a x\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\log_a x\) aur \(\log_x a\) ek cheez nahi; ek doosre ke ulte hain. In ko mix karna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq numbers se: \(a = 2, b = 4, c = 8\) (G.P.) aur \(x = 64\) lein. \(\log_2 64 = 6\), \(\log_4 64 = 3\), \(\log_8 64 = 2\). Reciprocals \(\frac{1}{6}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{2}\) mein har dafa \(\frac{1}{6}\) ka farq hai, to 6, 3, 2 H.P. hai \(\checkmark\).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\log_a x, \log_b x, \log_c x\) H.P. mein hain.
